text: …　そうね　おとこのこは　いつか　たびに　でるもの　なのよ　うん…　テレビの　はなしよ！

structure.jp: おとこのこは　いつか　たびに　でるもの　なのよ
structure.en: boys are the kind who leave on a journey someday

structure.jp: テレビの　はなしよ！

patterns.name: 〜ものだ
patterns.explanation: もの after a verb says 'that is just how things naturally are'. なのよ is a soft, womanly way to end it. でるもの　なのよ = 'they do leave, that's how it is'.
